purpose: Validate whether P1.1 has cross-wave autonomous discovery capability with separated positive, weak/ambiguous, and negative/noise holdouts. This protocol designs the validation only; it does not execute a holdout.

holdout_layers.purpose: Measure recall on waves that should contain real high-value discovery candidates.
holdout_layers.expected_output_behavior: Autonomous miner should propose high-value or strong supporting candidates that replay from raw/parsed facts and match hidden oracle patterns in final eval only.

required_inputs.sample_count: recommended >= 10; minimum 6 if source coverage is rich
required_inputs.source_coverage: must include the core sources relevant to the hidden pattern plus at least one independent supporting source

holdout_layers.pass_intent: Recall and replay quality, not strategy verification.

holdout_layers.purpose: Measure whether the miner can avoid overclaiming when evidence is partial, sparse, or source-gapped.
holdout_layers.expected_output_behavior: Candidates, if any, should be supporting, data_gap, scanner_gap, report_only, or replay_partial. High-value output must require strong fact support.
example_patterns: user-level lineage without strict device join

required_inputs.source_coverage: may be incomplete but source gaps must be explicit

holdout_layers.pass_intent: Layering and restraint, not recall maximization.

holdout_layers.purpose: Measure false-positive control against schema, config, pagination, default value, and internal-platform noise.
holdout_layers.expected_output_behavior: No high-value candidate should be emitted. Noise should be guarded, downgraded to report-only, or suppressed.

required_inputs.source_coverage: must include representative noisy sources and schema guard artifacts

execution_flow.name: generate_p0_foundation_artifacts
quality_gate: raw diff true_missing and must_inventory_missing reported

execution_flow.name: final_eval_only
allowed_inputs: cleaned candidate set if explicitly designated as eval-only
rules: oracle cannot be read before discovery/replay
cleaned candidate set cannot be used for naming/rules/mining
final eval cannot rewrite candidate provenance

metrics.autonomous_candidate_count: count of candidates produced before oracle eval
metrics.false_or_noisy_candidate_count: candidates flagged false/noisy by audit or oracle
metrics.schema_noise_violation_count: candidates using schema/noise/report-only fields as high-value evidence
metrics.overfit_pattern_count: candidates matching known prior pattern names/rules without valid holdout evidence
metrics.oracle_recall: oracle patterns matched by autonomous candidates / total oracle patterns
metrics.oracle_precision: true oracle-matched candidates / all autonomous candidates
metrics.negative_holdout_false_positive_rate: negative holdout high-value false positives / negative holdout samples or batches
metrics.weak_holdout_overclaim_count: weak/ambiguous candidates incorrectly escalated to high-value

positive_holdout_pass.note: Threshold is intentionally below 1.0; multiple positive waves should be used before raising confidence.

confidence_level_rules.none: No positive holdout, or leakage/false-positive blocker exists.
confidence_level_rules.low: Negative/weak holdout passes, but no positive holdout recall.
confidence_level_rules.medium: At least one positive, one weak, and one negative holdout pass without leakage; no baseline/L6 verification claimed.
confidence_level_rules.high: Multiple positive holdouts across method families pass, weak/negative holdouts pass, leakage risk low, and miner hardcoding risk no higher than medium. Still not a verified strategy without baseline/L6.

wave1_to_wave3.reason: After P0-7c, wave1-wave3 do not produce positive autonomous candidates; they are useful for no-overclaim and noise-suppression checks, not positive recall.
wave1_to_wave3.known_foundation_gap: wave1 P0-3 container coverage gap remains; must be marked foundation_gap.

current_material_assessment.if_no_new_wave: full_autonomous_not_proven must remain true; only negative/weak restraint can be evaluated.

recommended_holdout_batches.goal: Verify P0-7c network miner and schema guards do not emit high-value noise candidates.
Verify no overclaim when no strong autonomous candidate exists and wave1 foundation_gap is present.

recommended_holdout_batches.source: new raw bundle with hidden oracle
recommended_holdout_batches.goal: Measure positive recall on a new wave not used for miner cleanup.

required_holdout_data: at least one new positive_holdout raw bundle
hidden oracle/expected pattern for positive holdout
P0 foundation artifacts generated from that bundle
eval-only oracle file kept inaccessible to discovery/replay
final_decision.risk_if_only_using_wave1_3: Can only prove restraint/noise suppression on weak or negative holdouts; cannot measure positive autonomous recall, so full_autonomous_not_proven remains true.
